After 13 years leading ARH, Eric Hanna announced his retirement, with the board appointing Leah Levesque, then Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive at Queensway Carleton Hospital and a former six-year ARH senior leader, as his successor, effective October 1, 2021, following Hanna's retirement on September 30, 2021. The board framed her mandate around steering ARH through post-COVID recovery, long-term care program growth, launch of the Ontario Health Team, and strategic technology investment.

items.date_raw: Announced May 10, 2024; Stevenson joined in August 2024
items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health / Boyden press release
items.verbatim_snippet: Following a formal search, ARH's Board of Directors announced Jeremy Stevenson as its next President and CEO, describing him as a results-oriented healthcare leader with acute and long-term care experience. Stevenson came from St. Joseph's General Hospital Elliot Lake, with prior roles as CEO of the North East LHIN, CEO of Mattawa Hospital and Algonquin Nursing Home, and COO of St. Francis Memorial Hospital in Barry's Bay.
